word_translation_en: to regulate; to control; to settle
sentence_example: Wir müssen diese Angelegenheit so schnell wie möglich regeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: We must settle this matter as quickly as possible.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы должны уладить это дело как можно скорее.
sentence_synonym: Wir müssen diese Angelegenheit so schnell wie möglich klären.
typical_collocations: eine Angelegenheit regeln; den Verkehr regeln; die Heizung regeln; gesetzlich geregelt
usage_comments_en: 'regeln' means to control/adjust a process or to settle/resolve a matter. In technical contexts, it means automatically maintaining a state (unlike 'steuern', which is open-loop control). In daily life, it often means 'to sort out' or 'to take care of' a problem.

word_translation_en: to readjust; to fine-tune a control system
sentence_example: Der Thermostat muss die Raumtemperatur automatisch nachregeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: The thermostat must automatically readjust the room temperature.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Термостат должен автоматически корректировать комнатную температуру.
sentence_synonym: Der Thermostat muss die Raumtemperatur automatisch nachjustieren.
typical_collocations: die Temperatur nachregeln; die Leistung nachregeln
usage_comments_en: Technical term in engineering, control systems, and electronics. Separable verb meaning subsequent or continuous automatic adjustments.

sentence_example: Das System wird die Leistung automatisch abregeln.
sentence_example_translation_en: The system will automatically throttle the power.
sentence_synonym: Das System wird die Leistung automatisch drosseln.
typical_collocations: die Drehzahl abregeln; den Strom abregeln
usage_comments_en: Technical separable verb used for electronics or mechanical systems.
